summary: Your database stays lean at busy installs, and jobs keep enough power for your tenant.

fixes.title: Old collections cleaned up during runs
fixes.text: At installs with back-to-back runs, older data is now removed while a run is going. It waits when the database is busy and never slows a run or a ServiceNow send.

fixes.title: Every update checks job sizes
fixes.text: Each update now checks the processing power and memory of the jobs and the web app, and raises any that is too small for your tenant.
